pencereler.0-5: An airliner crashed into the Atlantic off Nova Scotia. It had caught fire in
pencereler.5-12: flight, and all two hundred twenty nine aboard were killed. The crew smelled smoke in the cockpit. The fire
pencereler.12-20: was hidden above the ceiling. Arcing wires had ignited the insulation blankets there. The fire spread unseen and knocked out systems one
pencereler.20-30: by one. The jet went down before it could land. Flammable insulation was replaced across airliner fleets.

segmentler.metin: Swissair Flight 111 crashed into the Atlantic after a cockpit fire.
It took only arcing wires above the cockpit ceiling.
So how could arcing wires above the cockpit ceiling do this?
The answer is electrical arcing igniting flammable insulation blankets in the ceiling — and it is why flammable insulation blankets were replaced across airliner fleets.
